Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art GAME SPRITE SHEET for Escape Bincov, not a scene or concept painting.
Create ONE pharmacy wall-shelf modular set, exactly FIVE isolated sprites in ONE horizontal row, equal-sized cells. Left-to-right: west end, east end, middle A stocked, middle B partly looted, standalone with both end panels. All five shelves identical geometry. Actual final module is 32 pixels wide by 80 high, made at 8x integer pixel zoom for this source. Each shelf has a 32x32 square footprint, and height extrusion of 48 px, screen equation y=48+depth-height. Entire canvas of each module filled from top to bottom by its rectangular cabinet: top face occupies first 32px, vertical SOUTH front face the bottom 48px. Top face horizontal rectangle, not diamond. Camera looks from due south at elevated 45 degrees; X edges EXACTLY HORIZONTAL, depth edges EXACTLY VERTICAL in the image. ZERO isometric skew, ZERO visible east/west side face, no vanishing point. Each silhouette is exactly a tall rectangle (width:height =32:80), top panel 40% of sprite height, south/front panel 60%.
Reference image 1 is existing shipped pixel shelf style. Reference image 2 shows required geometry; match the upper-left pharmacy shelf geometry, improve material and object detail only.
Dusty off-white metal and pale sage trim, four shelves of small medicine cartons and bottles in ivory, faded teal, muted blue, occasional dusty salmon, subtle grime and missing packets. Minimal medicine packaging marks, NO readable typography, logos or cross signs. Top surface shows one or two small dusty cardboard packages, mostly open worktop surface. Light from upper left, muted coastal abandoned mall palette, hand-placed crisp pixels, 20-28 colors. Match existing low-resolution pixel density, clean clusters not dithering noise.
All modules have identical cabinet top and front face boundaries so they join edge to edge. End-w has left outer upright only; end-e right outer upright only; middle pieces have no closed outer sides; single both uprights. Middle A and B have different products, exact same shelves.
Generous transparent gutters BETWEEN the five sprites. Sprites aligned to SAME top and same bottom with identical width. No floor, ground plane, cast shadow, glow, bloom, text, label, frame or border. Background truly transparent, hard alpha only. Sprite shape must extend to left/right edge and full south/bottom baseline of its footprint. Use only top and south faces.
